title: UI Playground
subtitle: A live inventory of the primitives, tokens and states that ship with FishAdmin. Every demo uses the same theme, locale and accessibility rules as the product.

hero.title: Every primitive, one workspace.
hero.description: Buttons, forms, overlays, navigation and edge cases — built on Radix, styled with Tailwind tokens, and translated end to end. Change the theme or locale and every example reacts instantly.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.description: Semantic color tokens, typography and elevation that every component shares.

actions.title: Buttons & actions
actions.description: Variants, sizes, badges, segmented controls and identity.

forms.title: Form controls
forms.description: Labelled inputs, validation-ready fields and locale-aware pickers.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Alerts, progress, loading placeholders, toasts and contextual hints.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.description: Dialogs, sheets, drawers, menus and popovers — all keyboard accessible.

navigation.title: Navigation & disclosure
navigation.description: Tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination and accordions for dense screens.

layout.title: Layout & data
layout.description: Resizable panels, scroll regions and compact tables.

states.title: Auth & status screens
states.description: Every edge screen ships with a route, a guard and a copy deck.

foundations.typeDisplay: Design that stays out of the way.
foundations.typeBody: Body copy at 14px with relaxed line height keeps dense admin screens readable.

navigation.tabOverviewBody: Overview content swaps without leaving the page.
navigation.tabActivityBody: Activity panels reuse the same surface and spacing.
navigation.tabSettingsBody: Settings tabs keep related controls together.
navigation.accordionA1: Navigation, routes and buttons all read the same permission union. It is a UX layer only — a real backend must enforce authorization.
navigation.accordionQ2: Can I turn off the mock API?
navigation.accordionA2: Set VITE_ENABLE_MOCK=false and point the API client at your server. The worker is never registered.
navigation.accordionQ3: How do I add a new accent?
navigation.accordionA3: Add an oklch token block in styles/index.css and one entry in config/theme.ts. Every component follows.

layout.resizableHint: Drag the handle to resize — sizes persist within the session.

states.authNote: Auth screens redirect to the dashboard while a session exists — sign out to explore them.
states.statusNote: 401, 500, 503 and maintenance are public. 403 keeps the app shell so you can navigate away.
